entities.summary: Nathan Solomon Kapahukula Knight is an American professional basketball player for the Goyang Sono Skygunners of the Korean Basketball League (KBL), where he was named the 2025–26 KBL All-Star Game MVP. He played college basketball for the William & Mary Tribe and was the NCAA Division I mid-major national player of the year when he won the Lou Henson Award.
